title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge to Amazon SQS fanout
description: Routes from Amazon API Gateway REST API to SQS via EventBridge.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API gateway REST API endpoint. The endpoint uses service integrations to directly connect to Amazon EventBridge.
A rule evaluates whether the event should be sent to two distinct SQS queues.
This fanout pattern uses EventBridge with SQS targets.
